title: GLASS ADJUSTMENT PROCEDURE
summary: Door window (side glass) adjustment points, all models. No part list: the drawing letters the screws and bolts (A through H) that are loosened and retightened when fitting the door glass: the windshield-pillar weatherstrip retainer screws, the guide-cam bolts at the belt line (Views A and B), the mid-door cam bracket bolts, the anti-rattle cushion bolts (View C) and the window stop screws at the top and bottom of the glass channels.

fastening.note: Screws "A" (3) go through the long retainer strip at the front of the window opening, top, middle and bottom.

fastening.to: door inner panel belt line, top of the front glass channel
fastening.note: View A: two bolts "B" at the outer ends and two bolts "F" in the middle go down through the bracket at the top of the front channel; screw "E" goes through a slot in the side of the channel.

fastening.to: door inner panel belt line, top of the rear glass channel
fastening.note: View B: two bolts "B" go down through the bracket at the top of the rear channel; bolt "D" goes down through a slotted hole beside it; screw "E" goes through a slot in the side of the channel.
View C: bolt "D" goes down through the slotted bracket at the front of the belt line.

fastening.to: door inner panel, upper front of the front glass channel
fastening.note: Main view: screw "E" goes into the front channel just below the belt line.
Main view: two bolts "C" go through the bracket at mid-door; bolt "G" is at the lower end of the rear channel next to it.

fastening.to: lower ends of the front and rear glass channels
fastening.note: Main view: screw "F" and screw "H" go into the bracket at the lower end of the front channel; a second screw "H" goes into the bracket at the lower end of the rear channel.

notes_internal: No callout list, no part numbers, torque legend triangles are blank, no revisions. Letters A-H key to written procedure steps that are not on this page.

Page 151 (sheet K12, coupe 19437, same title) carries a procedure text that names these letters: A = w/shield side w/strip retainer screws, B = guide cam upper attaching bolts, C = idler cam attaching bolts, D = anti-rattle cushion bolts, E = upper stop screws, F = fore/aft screws, G = rear guide cam lower attaching bolt, H = lower stop screws. Used here only as context; descriptions above are from the drawing.
A dimension arrow pair is drawn at the glass front edge near the top of the door (no value).
